claims: General John Daniel "Dan" Caine became the 22nd Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff on April 11, 2025.
Gen. Dan Caine was born August 10, 1968, in Elmira, New York.
Gen. Dan Caine is the son of USAF Lt. Col. (Ret.) Steve Caine.
Gen. Dan Caine graduated from Virginia Military Institute in 1990 with a B.S. in Economics.
Gen. Dan Caine holds a Master of Arts in Air Warfare from American Military University.
Gen. Dan Caine was commissioned in 1990.
Gen. Dan Caine is a command pilot with over 2,800 F-16 hours, including 150+ combat hours.
Gen. Dan Caine served as CIA Associate Director for Military Affairs.
Gen. Dan Caine served as Director of Operations at the CIA.
Gen. Dan Caine was a part-time National Guard member from 2009-2016.
President Trump nominated Gen. Dan Caine to lead the military.
Gen. Dan Caine served as a weapons officer.
Gen. Dan Caine commanded at various levels before his appointment to the Joint Staff.
In March 2026, Gen. Dan Caine appeared with Defense Secretary Pete Hegesth to address security concerns regarding Iran.
